brief: Correct human scale on the existing matte Swedish great-power-era quay oil painting. Keep camera, ship, gate and walkable outline. Use small practical lanterns, thin mooring rope and small cobbles; no people or UI. Replace floor medallions with traversable memorial slabs with incised serpent bands and handprints; add a third slab near the gate. No gloss, no toy forms. Request assumed a 135px adult; runtime was visually calibrated to 150px after inspecting actual output.
